scope: CellposeDINO ViT-B representation audit only. No Cellpose mask dynamics, affinity head, target adaptation, protected-regression access, or biological promotion occurred.

direct_output_result.evidence: No Train-A-declared Cellpose flow/cell-probability descriptor was consistently discriminative across V1, V2, and V3.

internal_feature_result.feature_contract: Final CPDINO encoder.norm token after CLS/storage-token removal, bilinearly sampled at reviewed raw coordinates. XY 2-D encoder only.
internal_feature_result.interpretation: A single axis-balanced region contains an exploratory feature contrast. It does not demonstrate spatial generalization.

confounding_audit.conclusion: The frozen cohort cannot supply a Train-A-selected, cross-region, axis-controlled encoder separability test. Physical affinity axis can otherwise explain the observed class difference.

next_required_evidence: A separately versioned, spatially independent expert-review cohort containing both SAME_PROCESS and DIFFERENT_PROCESS examples for each evaluated Z/Y/X axis in TRAIN and VALIDATION. It must be collected before a representation-selection or affinity-head experiment.
